description: This Java class represents an HTTP publish target, which defines the HTTP method and path/query to which messages can be sent. It includes factory methods to create instances from string addresses, as well as standard overrides for equality, hash code, and string representation.

classes.name: HttpPublishTarget
classes.description: An immutable class representing an HTTP target with methods to parse and create instances based on address strings.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method for the target.

methods.name: getPathWithQuery
methods.description: Returns the path including query parameters for the HTTP request.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an HttpPublishTarget instance from a string of format '<HTTP_METHOD>:/<HTTP_PATH_INCL_PARAMS>', defaulting to POST if parsing fails.

methods.name: splitMethodAndPath
methods.description: Splits the target address string into method and path components based on ':' separator.
